tasks.label: Biên dịch & Sao chép CSS
tasks.command: javac -d build/classes -cp "lib/*;src" (Get-ChildItem -Path src,test -Filter "*.java" -Recurse | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName); $srcRes = "src"; $buildRes = "build/classes"; Get-ChildItem -Path $srcRes -Filter "*.css" -Recurse | ForEach-Object { $rel = $_.FullName.Substring((Resolve-Path $srcRes).Path.Length + 1); $target = Join-Path $buildRes $rel; $targetDir = Split-Path $target -Parent; if (-not (Test-Path $targetDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetDir -Force | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $target -Force }
